card.line: Gilead is a hilly, grassy region east of the Jordan River, good for herds, where Jacob met Laban, tribes settled, and Jephthah and Elijah lived.

moments.title: Laban catches Jacob
moments.text: Jacob fled toward the hill country of Gilead, and Laban chased him for seven days and overtook him there. That night God warned Laban in a dream not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.

moments.title: Tribes want the land
moments.text: The Reubenites and Gadites had very large herds and flocks. They saw that Gilead was suitable for livestock and asked Moses to give them the land so they would not have to cross the Jordan.

moments.title: Elders call Jephthah
moments.text: When the Ammonites made war on Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah, whom they had expelled. They asked him to lead them, and the people made him their leader and commander.

moments.title: Gilead fights Ephraim
moments.text: Jephthah gathered the men of Gilead to fight Ephraim. The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan and questioned any fugitive who tried to cross. When Jephthah died, he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

moments.title: Elijah speaks to Ahab
moments.text: Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, told King Ahab that there would be no dew or rain in the coming years except at his word.
